en.hubeali: H 14807 – Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Washa, from Muhammad Bin Al-Fazeyl, from Abu Hamza who said:

I heard Abu Ja’farasws saying: ‘There is no one from this community who has made a Religion for himself with the Religion of Ibrahimas except for usasws, and ourasws Shites. And there is none who is upon the guidance who has been guided from this community except by usasws, nor has he strayed, the one who has strayed from this community, except due to (opposing) usasws’.
en.sarwar: 360. Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Mu‘alla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Washa, from Muhammad Bin Al-Fazeyl, from Abu Hamza who said:

I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s.) saying: ‘There is no one from this community who has made a Religion for himself with the Religion of Ibrahim (as) except for us (a.s.), and our (a.s.) Shites. And there is none who is upon the guidance who has been guided from this community except by us (a.s.), nor has he strayed, the one who has strayed from this community, except due to (opposing) us (a.s.)’.
